title: Mujhko Maloom Hai Abid Peh Qayamat Guzari
body:
Bharay Bazaar Seh (x2) Jab Malika-e-Ghairat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mola Shabbir Seh Sajaad Talak Atay Huway (x2)
Khoon May Doobh Kay (x2) Maqtal Seh Imamat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaari Shabbir Zamanay May Baray Dekhay Hain (x2)
Nok-e-Naiza Peh (x2) Bus Teri Talawat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zarf-e-Qatil Ko Parakhnay Kay Liye Asghar Tah (x2)
Kisi Masoom Ki (x2) Aisi Na Shahadat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haar Bashar Roya Hai Ek Jaisa Bharay Aalam May (x2)
Is Kay Ashko Si (x2) Duniya May Nah Rangat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kay Bazaar Main Zainab Kuch Istara Jaisa (x2)
Haaya Kay Kabaar Main (x2) Lipati Howi Mayaat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiskay Parday Ka Nighaiban Tah Abbas-e-jaari (x2)
Kaisay Darbaaro Seh (x2) Buniyad Sharafat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Pata Khoon Jigaar Cheer Peh Aansu Hai Bana (x2)
Haye Sajaad Peh (x2) Kya Kya Na Museebat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Ghiray Ghaash Seh Toh Beemar Ghiray Sajday Main (x2)
Bhari Sajdou Seh (x2) Sajaad Ki Fidaraat Guzari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Choomta Rehta Hai Adil To Unhi Raahon Ko (x2)
Mola Abid Ki (x2) Jis Raah Seh Ziarat Guzari.
